variables.scientific_justification: Terra MOPITT Level 3 Monthly Joint TIR/NIR (MOP03JM v10) maximizes sensitivity to near-surface and column CO mixing ratios over land and urban plumes.
variables.physical_distinction_note: Measures ambient atmospheric CO concentration/column abundance, NOT surface emission inventories or anthropogenic fluxes.

variables.scientific_justification: NASA MERRA-2 Monthly Aerosol Diagnostics (M2TMNXAER v5.12.4) provides gap-free global assimilated surface mass concentration (BCSMASS) from 1980–present.
variables.physical_distinction_note: Represents model-assimilated ambient surface mass concentration, NOT incomplete combustion emission fluxes.

variables.scientific_justification: NASA MERRA-2 M2TMNXAER (OCSMASS) provides continuous monthly organic carbon aerosol surface mass assimilated with MODIS/MISR/AERONET AOD.
variables.physical_distinction_note: Measures atmospheric organic carbon mass concentration, NOT biomass-burning carbon emissions.

variables.scientific_justification: NASA MERRA-2 M2TMNXAER (SO4SMASS) captures monthly sulfate aerosol mass concentration driven by secondary sulfur oxidation.
variables.physical_distinction_note: Measures atmospheric sulfate aerosol mass concentration, NOT SO2 emissions.

variables.scientific_justification: MODIS/Terra Level 3 Monthly (MOD08_M3 v6.1) combines Dark Target and Deep Blue retrievals across vegetated and bright desert surfaces (Thar Desert, Indo-Gangetic Plain).
variables.physical_distinction_note: AOD measures column-integrated solar light extinction by all aerosols aloft, NOT surface PM2.5 mass concentration.

variables.scientific_justification: AIRS/Aqua Level 3 Monthly (AIRX3STM v7.0) provides long-term global mid-tropospheric CH4 volume mixing ratios, complemented by Copernicus CAMS EGG4 reanalysis.
variables.physical_distinction_note: Represents atmospheric CH4 mole fraction/volume mixing ratio, NOT surface wetland or agricultural CH4 flux.

variables.scientific_justification: MERRA-2 M2TMNXSLV (v5.12.4) and Copernicus ERA5 provide physically consistent global 2-meter shelter-height air temperature fields.
variables.physical_distinction_note: Screen-level air temperature at 2 m above ground, NOT radiometric Land Surface Temperature (LST).

variables.scientific_justification: MODIS/Terra Monthly CMG Land Surface Temperature (MOD11C3 v061, 0.05°) directly observes thermal infrared clear-sky radiometric skin temperature.
variables.physical_distinction_note: Radiometric skin temperature of soil/canopy under clear skies, NOT 2-meter ambient air temperature.

variables.scientific_justification: GPM IMERG Final Run V07 (GPM_3IMERGM) merges multi-satellite microwave/IR precipitation with GPCC gauges at 0.1° resolution, critical for monsoon gradients.
variables.physical_distinction_note: Satellite-gauge merged surface precipitation rate; reanalysis precipitation exhibits greater convective bias in tropical monsoons.

variables.scientific_justification: MERRA-2 M2TMNXSLV (SPEED / U10M, V10M) and ERA5 synthesize radiosonde, scatterometer, and synoptic pressure-gradient winds consistently.
variables.physical_distinction_note: Grid-cell vector/scalar mean 10-m wind speed; sub-grid topographic gusts are smoothed.

variables.scientific_justification: MERRA-2 M2TMNXSLV (QV2M) measures absolute water vapor mass per kilogram of moist air independently of temperature.
variables.physical_distinction_note: Specific humidity is mass mixing ratio (moisture supply), whereas Relative Humidity depends strongly on air temperature.

variables.scientific_justification: AIRS/Aqua Level 3 (RelHumSurf) and ERA5/POWER provide consistent percentage saturation relative to air temperature.
variables.physical_distinction_note: Ratio of vapor pressure to saturation vapor pressure (%): can decrease under warming even when absolute humidity rises.

variables.scientific_justification: SMAP Enhanced L3 (SPL3SMP_E v006, 9 km) directly senses top 0–5 cm soil dielectric water content using L-band radiometry.
variables.physical_distinction_note: Top-layer satellite sensing (0–5 cm), distinct from deeper root-zone moisture (0–100 cm).

variables.scientific_justification: GLDAS Noah 2.1 Monthly (GLDAS_NOAH025_M v2.1, 0.25°) simulates 0–100 cm root-zone moisture forced with GPCP precipitation.
variables.physical_distinction_note: Land-surface model state (not directly observed by passive microwave radar below ~5 cm).

variables.scientific_justification: GLDAS Noah 2.1 Monthly separates surface storm runoff (Qs_acc) and baseflow (Qsb_acc) across Indian river basins.
variables.physical_distinction_note: Unrouted grid-cell runoff flux, not gauge-measured downstream river discharge.

variables.scientific_justification: GLDAS Noah 2.1 Monthly Evap_tavg gives complete land-surface latent heat water flux consistent with soil moisture closure.
variables.physical_distinction_note: Actual evapotranspiration (water- and energy-limited), distinct from Potential Evapotranspiration (PET).

variables.scientific_justification: MODIS/Terra Monthly 0.05° CMG (MOD13C2 v061) provides BRDF-normalized red/NIR greenness across 2000–present.
variables.physical_distinction_note: Spectral canopy greenness ratio; saturates in dense tropical forests compared to EVI.

variables.scientific_justification: MOD13C2 v061 EVI reduces soil background brightness and residual aerosol effects over dense monsoon canopies.
variables.physical_distinction_note: Optical canopy structure/greenness index, not direct biomass or carbon flux.

variables.scientific_justification: MODIS/Terra Gap-Filled 8-Day GPP (MOD17A2HGF v061) combines fPAR/LAI with light-use efficiency meteorology.
variables.physical_distinction_note: Gross photosynthetic carbon uptake (before autotrophic respiration), not Net Ecosystem Exchange (NEE).

datasets.dataset_name: MOPITT Derived CO (Thermal + Near Infrared Radiances) Monthly Global Gridded L3
datasets.download_mechanism: CMR Granule Search + Authenticated HTTPS / earthaccess
datasets.data_limitations: Cloud-free scenes only; TIR/NIR joint retrievals require sunlit daytime conditions over land for NIR sensitivity.
datasets.scientific_justification: Highest multi-decade satellite record of surface/column CO concentration from Terra (2000–2025).

datasets.dataset_name: MERRA-2 tavgM_2d_chm_Nx: 2D Monthly Mean Atmospheric Chemistry
datasets.data_limitations: Reanalysis model output; reflects prior emission inventories coupled with chemistry transport.
datasets.scientific_justification: Gap-free 1980–present context extending prior to Terra MOPITT launch.

datasets.dataset_name: MERRA-2 tavgM_2d_aer_Nx: Black Carbon Surface Mass
datasets.data_limitations: AOD assimilation constrains total column extinction rather than speciated BC fractions directly.
datasets.scientific_justification: Standard global assimilated aerosol reanalysis used in South Asian black carbon studies.

datasets.dataset_name: MERRA-2 tavgM_2d_aer_Nx: Organic Carbon Surface Mass
datasets.data_limitations: Speciation follows GOCART optical properties and emissions.
datasets.scientific_justification: Captures seasonal crop-residue burning and biofuel OC trends across India.

datasets.dataset_name: MERRA-2 tavgM_2d_aer_Nx: Sulfate Surface Mass
datasets.data_limitations: Precursor SO2 chemistry relies on inventory updates.
datasets.scientific_justification: Continuous global monthly sulfate aerosol field spanning pre- and post-industrial regulation periods.

datasets.dataset_name: MODIS/Terra Aerosol Cloud Water Vapor Ozone Monthly L3 Global 1Deg CMG
datasets.download_mechanism: CMR Granule Search + Authenticated HTTPS / OPeNDAP
datasets.data_limitations: Monsoon cloud cover reduces monthly clear-sky sampling frequency; AOD != PM2.5.
datasets.scientific_justification: Dark Target + Deep Blue merged retrieval works over both vegetated belts and bright arid India.

datasets.dataset_name: MERRA-2 Total Aerosol Extinction AOT (550 nm)
datasets.data_limitations: Pre-2000 years lack MODIS AOD assimilation.
datasets.scientific_justification: Gap-free cloud-filled AOD benchmark complementing MODIS MOD08_M3.

datasets.dataset_name: AIRS/Aqua L3 Monthly Standard Physical Retrieval (CH4 & Relative Humidity)
datasets.data_limitations: Thermal IR sounder peaks in mid-to-upper troposphere (~300–500 hPa), lower sensitivity in boundary layer.
datasets.scientific_justification: 22+ year consistent satellite CH4 record.

datasets.dataset_name: Copernicus CAMS Global Greenhouse Gas Reanalysis (EGG4) Monthly CH4
datasets.data_limitations: EGG4 archive currently ends in December 2020.
datasets.scientific_justification: Provides vertical profile levels (surface to upper troposphere) complementing AIRS.

datasets.dataset_name: MERRA-2 tavgM_2d_slv_Nx: Single-Level Diagnostics (T2M, WIND, QV2M)
datasets.data_limitations: 0.5° grid averages elevation gradients in Himalayan and Western Ghats terrain.
datasets.scientific_justification: Homogenized 1980–present atmospheric assimilation.

datasets.dataset_name: NASA POWER Agroclimatology Monthly Gridded/Regional API
datasets.scientific_variable: 2-m Temperature / Precipitation / Wind / Humidity / Soil Wetness
datasets.download_mechanism: NASA POWER Regional NetCDF REST API
datasets.data_limitations: Regional NetCDF requests are capped at a 10°×10° bounding box per call; tiles can be mosaicked for India.
datasets.scientific_justification: Zero-auth live NetCDF & JSON access to MERRA-2 meteorology and model hydrology.

datasets.dataset_name: ERA5 Monthly Averaged Data on Single Levels (Copernicus CDS)
datasets.download_mechanism: CDS API (cdsapi) with server-side area/time subsetting
datasets.data_limitations: Requires valid Copernicus CDS account & license acceptance.
datasets.scientific_justification: Finer 0.25° global climate reanalysis benchmark since 1940.

datasets.dataset_name: MODIS/Terra Land Surface Temperature/Emissivity Monthly L3 Global 0.05Deg CMG
datasets.download_mechanism: AppEEARS Area Task (GeoTIFF/NetCDF) or CMR LPCLOUD HTTPS
datasets.data_limitations: Clear-sky bias (warm bias vs all-sky temperatures during monsoon clouds).
datasets.scientific_justification: Authoritative 0.05° multi-decade thermal IR skin temperature product.

datasets.dataset_name: GPM IMERG Final Precipitation L3 1 month 0.1 degree x 0.1 degree V07
datasets.download_mechanism: GES DISC OPeNDAP (NetCDF subset) / CMR HTTPS
datasets.data_limitations: 3.5-month Final Run latency; high-elevation Himalayan snowfall uncertainty.
datasets.scientific_justification: 0.1° gauge-calibrated multi-satellite precipitation standard across India since 1998.

datasets.dataset_name: MERRA-2 tavgM_2d_flx_Nx: Bias-Corrected Total Precipitation
datasets.data_limitations: Coarser 0.5° resolution than GPM IMERG (0.1°).
datasets.scientific_justification: Matches NASA POWER PRECTOTCORR series used in TerraShift case studies.

datasets.dataset_name: MERRA-2 tavgM_2d_slv_Nx: 10-m Wind Components & Speed
datasets.data_limitations: Vector-averaged monthly wind components differ slightly from scalar mean speed.
datasets.scientific_justification: Complete 1980–present wind climatology for monsoon onset and coastal wind analysis.

datasets.dataset_name: MERRA-2 tavgM_2d_slv_Nx: 2-m Specific Humidity
datasets.data_limitations: Assimilated surface moisture sensitivity in sparse synoptic regions.
datasets.scientific_justification: Tracks atmospheric moisture capacity changes under Clausius-Clapeyron warming.

datasets.dataset_name: AIRS/Aqua L3 Monthly Surface Relative Humidity
datasets.data_limitations: Satellite IR retrieval fails under optically thick clouds.
datasets.scientific_justification: Direct satellite sounder humidity profile.

datasets.dataset_name: SMAP Enhanced L3 Radiometer Global and Northern Hemisphere Daily 9 km EASE-Grid Soil Moisture
datasets.download_mechanism: CMR Granule Search + NSIDC Authenticated HTTPS / AppEEARS
datasets.data_limitations: Starts March 2015; Radio Frequency Interference (RFI) and dense forest canopy degrade retrievals.
datasets.scientific_justification: Gold-standard L-band microwave surface soil moisture (0–5 cm) at 9 km resolution.

datasets.dataset_name: GLDAS Noah Land Surface Model L4 Monthly 0.25 x 0.25 degree V2.1 (Soil Moisture)
datasets.data_limitations: Unassimilated land-surface model; heavy groundwater pumping for irrigation in NW India is not explicitly simulated.
datasets.scientific_justification: 0.25° physically consistent soil moisture column closing water and energy budgets.

datasets.dataset_name: MERRA-2 tavgM_2d_lnd_Nx: Root-Zone Soil Wetness
datasets.data_limitations: Model-derived wetness fraction (relative to soil porosity).
datasets.scientific_justification: 1980–present consistency matching TerraShift case files.

datasets.dataset_name: GLDAS Noah Land Surface Model L4 Monthly 0.25 degree V2.1 (Runoff)
datasets.data_limitations: Reservoir regulation and inter-basin canals are not routed automatically.
datasets.scientific_justification: Separates fast storm runoff from baseflow across river basins.

datasets.dataset_name: GLDAS Noah Land Surface Model L4 Monthly 0.25 degree V2.1 (Evapotranspiration)
datasets.data_limitations: Does not ingest canal irrigation water additions in Punjab/Haryana unless forced.
datasets.scientific_justification: Standard energy-balance actual ET dataset from 2000–present.

datasets.dataset_name: MODIS/Terra Vegetation Indices Monthly L3 Global 0.05Deg CMG (NDVI)
datasets.data_limitations: Saturates at high LAI (>4) and sensitive to residual monsoon cloud contamination.
datasets.scientific_justification: 25-year global 0.05° vegetation greenness standard.

datasets.dataset_name: MODIS/Terra Vegetation Indices Monthly L3 Global 0.05Deg CMG (EVI)
datasets.data_limitations: Requires aerosol/blue-band quality filtering; cloud shadows drop EVI.
datasets.scientific_justification: Improves sensitivity over dense humid forests (Western Ghats, Northeast India).

datasets.dataset_name: MODIS/Terra Gross Primary Productivity Gap-Filled 8-Day L4 Global 500m SIN Grid
datasets.data_limitations: Crops under intensive fertilization can exceed biome-specific Light Use Efficiency assumptions.
datasets.scientific_justification: Directly quantifies photosynthetic carbon assimilation beyond spectral greenness indices.

datasets.dataset_name: OMI/Aura NO2 Cloud-Screened Total and Tropospheric Column L3 Global Gridded 0.25 degree
datasets.download_mechanism: GES DISC OPeNDAP / Giovanni / Earthdata HTTPS
datasets.data_limitations: Cloud-screened (<30% cloud radiative fraction); row anomaly reduces swath coverage post-2009.
datasets.scientific_justification: Directly measures satellite tropospheric nitrogen dioxide column over Indian urban-industrial corridors and thermal power belts.
